Who is KubeCon + CloudNativeCon NA for? Platform engineers & SREs, devs & DBAs whose app just moved onto #Kubernetes, & anyone choosing what to adopt next. Salt Lake City, Nov 9-12, in person.

400+ sessions on AI infrastructure, platform engineering, observability & databases on Kubernetes, plus Maintainer Tracks to ask the people who write the code.

We'll be at Booth #366 talking #PostgreSQL on Kubernetes. 🐘

Register: 🎟️ https://events.linuxfoundation.org/kubecon-cloudnativecon-north-america

#KubeCon #CloudNativeCon #OpenSource
